title: Unified Heterogeneous Feature Interaction via Effective-Rank Scaling for Recommender Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.35318v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large-scale industrial ranking models must jointly capture heterogeneous feature interactions, long-term user behaviors, and multi-scenario dependencies under stringent online serving constraints. Existing architectures typically process sequential and non-sequential features with separate modules, limiting bidirectional information exchange. Directly applying homogeneous self-attention to all semantic tokens can also be inefficient when sequential and non-sequential signals exhibit different effective-ranks (eRanks). Meanwhile, shared representations can overlook scenario-specific patterns and induce negative transfer between scenarios. In this paper, we propose HiRank, a unified framework for multi-scenario recommendation that jointly models Heterogeneous feature Interactions via effective-Rank scaling. HiRank integrates gated sequential attention with heterogeneous feature interaction within a unified backbone, enabling bidirectional

translated_title: 基于有效秩缩放的推荐系统统一异构特征交互
translated_abstract: 大规模工业级排序模型必须在严格的在线服务约束下，同时捕获异构特征交互、长期用户行为和多场景依赖关系。现有架构通常使用独立的模块来处理序列特征和非序列特征，限制了双向信息交换。此外，当序列信号和非序列信号表现出不同的有效秩时，直接对所有语义标记应用同构自注意力可能效率低下。同时，共享表征可能会忽略场景特定的模式，并在不同场景之间引发负迁移。在本文中，我们提出了HiRank，这是一个用于多场景推荐的统一框架，通过有效秩缩放联合建模异构特征交互。HiRank在统一的主干网络中将门控序列注意力与异构特征交互相结合，实现双向……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了HiRank框架，通过有效秩缩放在统一主干中联合建模异构特征交互与门控序列注意力，解决了推荐系统中序列与非序列特征信息交换受限以及多场景负迁移的问题。
en_tdlr: HiRank is a unified multi-scenario recommendation framework that jointly models heterogeneous feature interactions via effective-rank scaling, integrating gated sequential attention within a single backbone to address limited bidirectional information exchange and negative transfer across scenarios.
